briefing: Trump's peace envoys visit Moscow and Kyiv this weekend to restart stalled Ukraine negotiations, signalling renewed US diplomatic push on the conflict.
AI chip supply crisis deepens as AI demand drains RAM availability, hitting consumer electronics production and creating broader supply-chain pressures.

US political backlash against AI surveillance intensifies as Republicans revolt against Flock AI systems, reflecting growing tech regulation concerns.
Together AI seeks Saudi Arabia data-center capacity to circumvent US restrictions on AI infrastructure, highlighting geopolitical tensions in AI development.

briefing: PSG lost 1-2 at home to Monaco on Friday in their worst Ligue 1 start in 19 years, remaining winless under Luis Enrique despite the manager's confidence the title race is far from decided.
Luis Enrique has implemented a new disciplinary measure this season, notably benching Lucas Digne for the Monaco match, signaling stricter management as PSG struggles to find consistency.
France national team coaching position remains open with Zinedine Zidane emerging as a leading candidate, though he reportedly had hesitations about the role.

briefing: US jobs data beat expectations, prompting major banks including Citigroup to delay rate-cut forecasts into 2027 and fueling hawkish Fed bets; Wall Street initially fell but risk assets recovered as investors recalibrate rate expectations.

Dollar weakened sharply against the yen as Japanese rate-hike bets intensified, while equity markets showed resilience despite higher-for-longer rate signals—your S&P 500 and ACWI holdings gained modestly.
Italy's Eni is doubling down in Venezuela with hopes of recovering debt, a significant play for your EU exposure and macro interest in European energy firms navigating geopolitical risk.

Repo market dynamics are drawing renewed scrutiny as a 'dark matter' of finance with outsized influence on central banks, bonds and pension plans—relevant to your structured finance and investment portfolio work.

China's 26% earnings growth failed to lift equities, signaling investor skepticism; separately, Xi seeks to bring a large CEO delegation to the US, adding geopolitical complexity to US-China relations.
